Gym oracle assertions need evidence for the inputs that actually ran. A matching checkout after the run cannot recover earlier loaded bytes. This receipt extends the existing framework diagnostic OUT channel and Gym trace; it does not authorize reusable test passes.

The measured counterexample is a bare repository import externalized by Vite. It is absent from configFileDependencies and can restore its file before reporter initialization. Both config disk snapshots can match the immutable commit while the main process evaluated different code. The early Node load hook retains the loaded bytes separately.

1. Read the original oracle trace, including the raw worker report, command outcome and missing-evidence list. Keep observed assertion failures even when positive authority is unavailable.
2. Compare sourceHashes and npmManifest hashes to the exact oracle commit. npm manifest identity does not identify imported script code or npm/native runtime.
3. Read configSources.evidence as reporter-init/end disk snapshots. Read configSources.loaded as originally witnessed native ESM/TypeScript or supported Vite ESM bundle inputs. Missing preload, unsupported bundle injection, absent source maps and runner/CommonJS config loaders remain unknown.
4. Read mainProcessSources.evidence as repository Node main-process inputs observed by that same hook, excluding the separately reported config population. Bare externalized repository imports and later native imports belong here. Unsupported loads, repeated differing loads, outside-repository paths and unreadable sources retain named gaps. Empty evidence is unknown.
5. Compare every observed source with its separate reference.pinCommit and immutable reference.sources. Both arms must have matching populations and stable hashes. Only the declared implementation is permitted to change between oracle arms in worker evidence. Do not replace unavailable Git blobs with current disk bytes.
6. Read commandProcessSources as per-process exit observations from the npm command and inherited Node descendants. Each Node execution context writes its observed repository inputs into a file named by PID and thread ID beside the same OUT channel; Gym retains the raw receipts, hashes the separately pinned Git population and cleans the temporary files after reading. Missing exits, unknown entrypoints, unsupported CommonJS loads, changed sources and unmatched pins withhold positive claims. This is an observed population, not proof that every descendant exited or was instrumented.
7. Inspect sourceCurrent, implementationCurrent, workerSourcesCurrent, npmManifestCurrent, configSnapshotsCurrent, configLoadedCurrent, mainProcessCurrent and commandProcessesCurrent. Positive task/no-regression signals require the applicable guards, complete assertion population and a valid process outcome. These checks establish only their declared receipt scopes.

Remaining closure includes the complete descendant population, preload/loader identity, external packages, native runtime, environment/config reads, submodules and remote pipeline generation. A stable main-process receipt does not establish that complete closure, a full accepted learning contract or shipment. Preserve those unknowns until separately measured.

Regression guards are in executed-config-load-capture.test.ts and the Gym runner/ports tests. The actual Git/npm/Vitest fixture loads a bare repository package, restores it before reporter init and verifies distinct loaded/current/pinned hashes. Native-hook tests cover stable inputs, self-restoration, CommonJS uncertainty, outside paths and differing repeat loads; ten runner counterexamples reject invalid main-process receipts.

Verification at the Oct 5 source unit: testing:run ee299aab-a20e-4a52-bf13-39abf80463ae passed 172 assertions with no failures or skips. This is current-build source evidence, not final release evidence.

Additional Oct 5 command-process regression: a real parent spawns a child that imports a helper and then restores its file. Exit receipts retain the different loaded and current bytes even though neither process instantiates the Vitest reporter. A later overriding preload can instead change what executes while an earlier hook observes unchanged disk bytes: other import/require/loader preloads therefore make the intermediate hashes null and retain node-loader-chain-unmeasured. The preload itself, dynamically registered loader chains, native/external code and descendants outside the observed population remain unresolved. PID and parent PID are diagnostic metadata, not authority or a complete process census.

Five native parent/child controls cover stable, self-restoring, CommonJS, overriding-preload and mutated-argv execution; nine runner counterexamples reject missing, empty, unknown, self-restored, dirty, missing-entrypoint, duplicate-process, wrong-pin and changed-population receipts. The real Git/npm/Vitest port fixture retains the repository command wrapper and its immutable reference. Final canonical run e3eaf71a-c8d7-4c37-9408-7eea8b0d4dbb passed 146 assertions, zero failures or skips; full test-config and focused Gym type checks were clean. These are bounded current-build source proofs, not complete runtime/native contract or release evidence.

The entrypoint is captured at preload installation, before command code can mutate process.argv or cwd. The native mutated-argv control failed before this correction (8709a899-11a5-4e1c-8d06-b5b8c98092ea, row 20717256) because exit-time metadata falsely named helper.mjs as the command; the fixed receipt retains child.mjs. Raw entry metadata never substitutes for loaded source evidence or complete descendant coverage.

Worker threads share their parent PID. A real worker control a79e7bdd-59d6-45c1-9168-dac101df60af (row20722000) retained only one receipt before the filename correction; bede8dd4-f467-4ac6-9318-6082df8523e7 (row20722003) retained two distinct receipts with the same PID. Thread entrypoints are explicitly unmeasured rather than copied from the parent argv, so their observations remain unknown. These receipts preserve evidence without claiming complete thread or descendant coverage.

The first-attempt result classifier also treats TestCase.diagnostic() as optional. An absent diagnostic marks that case unmeasured and continues, allowing a later observed retry miss to remain fail. The mixed absent-then-retry regression failed before the guard (a5cebc80-5966-4286-85d0-14c3e4448a87, row20724887); the missing-only case remains unknown. WI-10006093 records the verified source fix and is committed done.

Final combined source verification after these corrections: canonical run 9cc3aa84-8d08-410c-ba48-c0e16aa13c6b passed 192 assertions over the capture, reporter, Gym runner, real ports and AB files, with zero failures/skips. Full test-config typecheck and focused Gym typecheck were clean. Previous 146-pass evidence above describes its earlier measured source; the complete runtime/native contract and original release acceptance remain unresolved.


The committed-source loader also returns intermediate source receipts through its existing PAPERCUSP_COMMITTED_SOURCE_AUDIT JSONL channel. Each ESM receipt records the actual input and returned buffer SHA256, returned byte length, format, PID and loader-thread ID at node-esm-load-return. An uncommitted refusal has null returned fields. The immutable committed blob may differ from the dirty input; neither disk nor a later HEAD read supplies these observed hashes. A later loader such as tsx can still transform the returned source, and loader self-input remains unmeasured. The native counterexample executes TRANSFORMED while this boundary correctly records HEAD, proving why this receipt cannot identify final executed code.

Gym retains the exact raw JSONL as commandProcessSources.loaderReport, including on command failure, and removes its temporary file after reading. Missing audit remains unmeasured. The committed-source-loader-chain-not-closed marker remains even when audit exists; no aggregate codeHash, pass reuse or activation authority is inferred. Dated Oct 5 source verification: rows 20733487/20733488/20733489 passed 125 assertions across committed-source-loader (15), runner-ports (26) and gym-runner (84), with no skips.
